evidence.source: Explicit game-owner answer in the Backend chat for issue #234 on 13 November 2026
evidence.owner_answer: Use the existing Captain-loss return: last ordinary room, or the other if full (Recommended)

precedence: Narrow exception to the Food recorded-place return for a Captain killed after leaving Command. Reuse the inherited Captain-loss ordinary-room fallback. All other Food and parent rules remain unchanged.
decision: At the unchanged common return, Task start plus 32,500 ms, a Captain killed after leaving Command returns to the last ordinary room, otherwise the other ordinary room if full. Count eliminated occupants and use canonical free-slot order. Free C1 at this return. No early public relocation, capacity change or mid-round election.
